title: VoiceProfile
description: Metadata for a stored speaker voice profile used for zero-shot TTS cloning

profile_id.description: Unique ID. Auto-generated UUID on creation. e.g. 'spk_a1b2c3d4'

display_name.description: User-assigned name. e.g. 'Ram', 'Priya'. Null until user renames.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of first profile creation

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last clip replacement

clip_path.description: Relative path to reference WAV clip. e.g. 'voice_profiles/spk_a1b2c3d4/reference_clip.wav'

clip_duration_sec.description: Duration of reference clip in seconds. Minimum 8s enforced by extractor.

embedding_path.description: Relative path to speaker embedding .npy file. Generated by pyannote/WhisperX.

source_sessions.description: Session IDs where this speaker was identified

clip_quality_score.description: Heuristic quality score (0-1). Higher = cleaner audio. New clips replace existing only if score is higher.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code detected for this speaker. e.g. 'en', 'hi'

tts_engine_tested.description: Which TTS engine last tested this profile. e.g. 'cosyvoice2', 'omnivoice'
